'''Lem Krarr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Krarr had a substantial [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head, totaling ten thousand alive and six thousand dead. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[Kir Kanos]] tracked down Krarr and delivered him to the authorities alive. After being informed that Krarr was wanted for murdering fourteen [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]], Kanos killed him and took the lesser payout.<ref name="ce prologue">{{StoryCite|story=The Third Time Pays for All|book=Wikipedia:Dark Horse Presents|text=''Dark Horse Presents'' 1}}</ref>
